entry.title: Serabit el-Khadim

terrainReference.basis: Pinned standard Protomaps2026-10-14/Mapzen13–14 extract. Retain original native six-meter plateau grid and the independent building. Long wall segments follow sampled grade; upright stelae and chapel portals use separately sampled local footings with buried bottoms. Coarse DEM cannot resolve exact plateau paving, rock-cave thresholds or archaeological levels; this is approximate above-ground visualization. No broad invented podium, terrain replacement or excavation cutout.

entry.note: Exact-QID way580657250 is a mapped wall/archaeological extent about77.9x40m. It fixes center and undirected long axis; standard PMTiles named archaeological point35184952746082 corroborates the site. Native east/south at heading0; internal angle-0.452864836238rad.
